mapper.select:
select id, exception_name, exception_message, service_name, server_ip, env, remote_ip, request_url, request_type, create_time from bedrock_log_error ble
and ble.create_time >= #{param.startTime}
and ble.create_time <= #{param.endTime}
and ble.exception_name like concat('%',#{param.exceptionName},'%')
and ble.exception_message like concat('%',#{param.exceptionMessage},'%')
and ble.service_name like concat('%',#{param.serviceName},'%')
and ble.server_ip like concat('%',#{param.serverIp},'%')
and ble.remote_ip like concat('%',#{param.remoteIp},'%')
and ble.request_url like concat('%',#{param.requestUrl},'%')
and ble.request_type = #{param.requestType}
and ble.env like concat('%',#{param.env},'%')
order by ble.create_time desc
